sources.mass_at_pdi_lb: Apollo 11 Mission Report (MSC-00171), Table A-I: LM after descent orbit insertion cutoff 33 401.6 lb
sources.usable_propellant_lb: Propellant remaining at PDI: DPS load 18 260.5 lb (NASA TN D-6846, Table II) minus 268.0 lb used by descent orbit insertion (Apollo 11 Mission Report Table A-I: 33 669.6 lb at ignition, 33 401.6 lb at cutoff); unusable residuals are not subtracted
sources.max_thrust_lbf: NASA TN D-6846, System descriptions: maximum thrust approximately 10 000 lb (fixed throttle position)
sources.design_thrust_lbf: NASA TN D-6846: design thrust 10 500 lb
sources.throttle: NASA TN D-6846: throttleable between 10 and 60 percent of design thrust; commands above that use the fixed throttle position
sources.isp_s: NASA Apollo DPS flight evaluations: Apollo 9 time-integrated average specific impulse 309.7 s
